We used an emotion sensitivity and regulation paradigm 12 – 14 with different categories of emotional social stimuli.

description.value: Participants viewed negative, neutral, positive and erotic social pictures under look and safe instructions and rated their momentary emotional state.

spans.text: The paradigm we used ( Fig. 1 ) included a traditional “look” condition, requiring participants to attend to the pictures and respond naturally without altering their emotional state.

description.value: Participants viewed negative social pictures for 8 seconds under the look instruction and were instructed to attend to the pictures and respond naturally without altering their emotional state; afterward they rated their momentary emotional experience.
